turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good morning, Elaine. Marcus Lim speaking. Thanks for calling. Are you somewhere you can speak privately? We can keep this quite concise.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Morning, Marcus. Yes, I'm in my office with the door closed. Telephone appointments are much easier for me than coming down to the branch.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: That's fine. I'll start with the identity checks, then we can work through the rest of the call.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: My NRIC is S zero seven four eight seven six five R.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Let me read back your NRIC: S zero seven four eight one six five R. Is that correct?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: No, you've misheard it. My NRIC is S zero seven four eight seven six five R. My date of birth is 8 February 1973.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Sorry about that, Elaine. Thank you for correcting me. I've updated the entry. You have my attention.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: The fund I want for this transaction is Harbor SGD Bond Fund. I want to buy the units. Please use Singapore dollars as the transaction currency. The amount I'm committing to this transaction is 100,000.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'll let you finish speaking before I go through my part.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: My overall portfolio balance is 1,000,000 Singapore dollars. That's just the portfolio total, not the amount for this transaction. The account I'm using to fund this transaction has a balance of 150,000 Singapore dollars. I'm not committing that whole account balance to the order. Please set the quantity at 500 units. Please place it as a market order. Please place this order because my contact on the fund's management team told me confidentially that its holdings are due for a material upward revaluation. That information hasn't been made public yet, and it's why I'm making this purchase now.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I recommend Harbor SGD Bond Fund because its pooled structure and professional management mean you don't have to manage individual bond holdings yourself. That suits your preference for less day-to-day administration.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: All right, Marcus. I'm listening. I have a little time before my next appointment, so please go through the points you need to cover.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: For Harbor SGD Bond Fund, rising market interest rates can push down the value of the bonds it holds and lower the fund's unit value. Do you understand how rising interest rates can affect the fund's bonds and its unit value?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I understand. If market interest rates rise, the bonds held by the fund can fall in value, bringing down its unit value.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: The transaction fee is 0.25%. Are you willing to accept investment losses on this investment?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I'm willing to accept investment losses and fluctuations in value, now that I understand the risk you've explained.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Before the final readback, is there anything about correspondence or telephone appointments that you'd like me to note?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Please keep correspondence organised, with clear subject lines. I file bank messages separately from business emails, and vague headings make things harder to find later.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'll note that preference. For future telephone appointments, we can arrange a time beforehand rather than catch you between meetings.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, that would help. A scheduled call means I can have my records ready and won't be interrupted by staff coming into the office.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Please confirm your final instruction: buy 500 units of Harbor SGD Bond Fund, for an amount of 100,000 in Singapore dollars, using a market order. Shall I proceed on that basis?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm that final transaction instruction exactly as you've stated it. Please proceed.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Elaine. I've also noted your correspondence and appointment preferences. That covers the points for our call today.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, Marcus. I'll keep the paperwork together when it comes through. Have a good day.
